description: Dedicated HGRApi tool for POST api/ListingCreate/GetData. This is an explicit tool with a fixed endpoint; it is not a generic endpoint caller. HGRApi functional documentation: Purpose: Resolves one supplier URL into validated product and draft-listing data for the extension's manual product flow. ownerAgent: publication. Use when: Use when the extension submits one supplier URL and needs the product details required to prepare a manual product. Input: GetDataRequest body with Url and optional extension ExtraData. AliExpress URLs may include selected variation labels and a native skuId. Header channel: current ChannelOAuthId. Admin: false. Output: Returns ProductInformation and Listing when complete product details can be obtained. AliExpress manual imports refresh the selected SKU and full variation family from the supplier even when cached product details exist. Saved product data is used only with a price checked in the last 24 hours; otherwise the import reads the supplier and keeps the saved data if that read fails. ASOS UK, Matalan and Home Bargains imports refresh supplier data when the cached or browser-extracted product has no variations; the returned product uses its selected size identity to avoid an empty parent option and retain a stable size-specific URL. Explicit ASOS UK product URLs with a selected variant preserve that exact size and avoid adding a duplicate selected-size option when the same size is already present in the variation family. Explicit AliExpress SKU selections are preserved; invalid or conflicting selections return an error instead of substituting the first variation. Variation labels remain separate from other URL parameters. A successful product response may also include OtherUrls so the client can offer an optional switch to bulk publish. A recognized product whose details cannot be obtained returns ErrorType=UnknownProduct without OtherUrls; non-product pages may return OtherUrls for bulk discovery. Admin or impersonated sessions additionally receive Debug with extraction configuration excluding cookies, intermediate product snapshots, data-source decisions and final product/draft fields. Category filling is diagnosed separately through ChannelListing/GetCategorySpecifics; browser-side changes are not observed here. Search terms: listingcreate getdata. Send the exact request payload in body. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

channelOAuthId.description: ChannelOAuthId returned by hgr_list_channels for the selected visible store.
